notes:
Starting point: the branch already had Layercake.vw_silv_derived_retirement_date and the changed Layercake.usp_load_silv_member_base. The first run_tests passed 21 and failed 5 (TC-018-012 to TC-018-016). All 5 failed with error 468 (a collation conflict) inside Layercake.usp_load_silv_membership_events.

Change in this session: in usp_load_silv_membership_events, the five string columns of #ev_stage (event_nk, event_type, event_subtype, contact_no, campaign_quarter) are now declared COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT (answers.md, MOD-018 events load collation). The temp tables built from #ev_stage with SELECT INTO (#join_based, #join_cy, #lapse_cy, #readmit_cy) take that collation from it. Nothing else in the procedure changed: event logic, row set, logging and Phase 1 lower-case style are all as before. The down script restores the Phase 1 definition.

Unit tests (test_MOD018_dev, 7): one new test for the events load. It checks a Join and two Renewals, Practising before and Retired from retirement_date. It also checks that a rerun on unchanged data logs 0/0/0, that clearing the date updates one event in place with the same event_id, and the three etl_run_log rows.

Results: all 27 tests pass (20 Tester, 7 dev). The rollback round-trip passes and check passes. The sqlfluff findings are advisory and are almost all in the existing Phase 1 lower-case code, so they were left.

Handover (ASM-002, DES-001): after the first Phase 1 run on this migration, a human runs Layercake.usp_load_silver @RebuildFrom = <the affected_from date on the open 'member_profile' pending row> (or @FullRebuild = 1) once. Until then, past daily counts keep the old Practising / Retired split.

Test-first: the first run had 15 of 20 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 20 of 20 and 7 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
